data.comment: Chip in the header of an object opened through a public synonym

data.comment: Kind of a PL/SQL unit (tooltip; upper case as chip)

data.comment: Kind of a PL/SQL unit (tooltip; upper case as chip)

data.name: Invalid_MaterializedView
data.value: INVALID: needs to be recompiled, e.g. after a change to the base table. Queries keep working.

data.name: Invalid_View
data.value: INVALID: Oracle recompiles the view on the next access. If that fails (e.g. because a column is missing), the query returns an error.

data.name: Invalid_Other
data.value: INVALID: recompiled on the next call. If that fails, the call returns an error.

data.comment: Kind in the tooltip of an explorer item

data.comment: “Write” is the button in the status bar. {0} = shortcut hint like “ (Ctrl+S)” or empty

data.name: Tab_FormTitleWithKey
data.value: Show the selected row as a form beside the grid ({0} in the grid; with several rows selected: compare)

data.value: The workspace is read-only – unlock it to make changes.

data.name: Tab_RowMarkedForDeletion
data.value: The row is marked for deletion.

data.name: Tab_CompareTooMany
data.value: You can compare at most {0} rows – {1} are selected.

data.name: Tab_CompareTooFew
data.value: Select at least two loaded rows to compare.

data.comment: {0} = full CLR type of the entity

data.comment: Table column header (NOT NULL or empty)

data.value: No property in the C# model

data.name: Columns_EnumAsNumber
data.comment: An enum property stored as its number (no converter)

data.name: Columns_Definition
data.comment: Heading: the SQL definition of a view

data.name: Columns_DefinitionTruncated
data.value: Truncated – the definition is longer than 32,767 characters.

data.name: Columns_EnumValueWithDisplay
data.comment: Tooltip line of an enum member. {0} = member, {1} = its display name, {2} = value stored

data.name: Constraints_TypeOther
data.comment: Constraint type not known to FerretSharp (upper case like PRIMARY KEY)

data.name: Constraints_NotNullOne
data.value: {0} NOT NULL constraint is shown as “NOT NULL” in the Columns view.

data.name: Constraints_NotNullOther
data.value: {0} NOT NULL constraints are shown as “NOT NULL” in the Columns view.

data.name: Constraints_ModelRelationsHint
data.value: Navigations of the linked project without an FK constraint in the database – you can follow them in the grid with a right-click.

data.name: Indexes_ViewHasNone
data.value: Views have no indexes – queries use the indexes of the underlying tables.

data.comment: Followed by the foreign keys. {0} = number of foreign keys

data.name: Indexes_UnindexedFkOther
data.comment: Followed by the foreign keys. {0} = number of foreign keys

data.name: Indexes_UnindexedFkHint
data.value: Deleting or changing the key in the referenced table then locks this entire table and scans all of it; joins over the foreign key are slow as well.

data.name: Indexes_Invisible
data.comment: Index status (not used by the optimizer)

data.name: Dependencies_UsedBy
data.comment: Heading: objects that use this one

data.name: Dependencies_TableUsesNothing
data.value: A table does not use other objects.

data.name: Dependencies_OnlyAccessibleTo
data.value: Only objects {0} has access to are shown.

data.value: Only objects the user has access to are shown.

data.comment: {0} = synonym name, {1} = OWNER.NAME of the real object

data.name: Dependencies_ShowSourceViaSynonym
data.comment: {0} = synonym name, {1} = OWNER.NAME of the real object

data.name: Object_TableChip
data.comment: Chip: kind of the object (VIEW and MATERIALIZED VIEW stay as they are)

data.name: Object_RowsEstimate
data.comment: {0} = number of rows from the optimizer statistics

data.name: Object_RowsEstimateAnalyzed
data.comment: {0} = number of rows from the optimizer statistics, {1} = date they were gathered

data.name: Object_RowsEstimateTitle
data.value: According to the optimizer statistics – not exact. Exact: “Count rows” in the Data view.
data.comment: “Count rows” is the button in the footer of the data view

data.name: Object_NoStatisticsTitle
data.value: No optimizer statistics have been gathered for this table yet.

data.name: Ddl_NeedsCatalogRole
data.value: Oracle returns the DDL of objects in other schemas only with the SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE role.

data.name: Ddl_Source
data.value: From {0} – indexes, triggers and grants are not included.

data.name: TableLink_OtherSchema
data.value: In another schema without a synonym

data.name: PlSql_ViewSpecification
data.comment: View of a package tab; also the part of a compile error

data.name: PlSql_ViewSource
data.comment: View of a procedure, function or trigger tab

data.name: PlSql_ViewBody
data.comment: View of a package tab; also the part of a compile error

data.name: PlSql_ViewErrors
data.comment: View of a PL/SQL tab and its heading (compile errors)

data.name: PlSql_ViewOnly
data.comment: Hint in the toolbar of a PL/SQL tab

data.name: PlSql_ViewOnlyTitle
data.value: Running, editing and compiling PL/SQL is not part of FerretSharp.

data.name: PlSql_TriggerDisabledTitle
data.value: The trigger is disabled (ALTER TRIGGER … DISABLE) and does not fire.

data.name: PlSql_TriggerOn
data.comment: Trigger header: the table or object type it fires on. {0} = table link or object type

data.name: PlSql_SpecLastDdl
data.comment: Last DDL of a package specification. {0} = date and time

data.name: PlSql_BodyLastDdl
data.comment: Last DDL of a package body. {0} = date and time

data.name: PlSql_BodyNotVisibleTitle
data.value: No body visible: Oracle shows the body of a package in another schema only with the DEBUG privilege on it (or to its owner).

data.name: PlSql_BodyNotVisible
data.value: No body visible. Oracle shows the body of a package in another schema only with the DEBUG privilege on it (or to its owner); EXECUTE is enough only for the specification.

data.name: PlSql_InvokerRights
data.value: Runs with the privileges of the caller (invoker’s rights).

data.name: PlSql_DefinerRights
data.value: Runs with the privileges of the owner (definer’s rights).

data.name: PlSql_Wrapped
data.value: {0} The source was made unreadable with Oracle’s wrap utility and cannot be restored. Parameters and dependencies are still shown in the other views.

data.name: PlSql_SourceNotVisible
data.value: No source visible – the object was dropped, or the user lacks privileges on it.

data.name: PlSql_SpecDeclaresNothing
data.value: The specification declares no procedures or functions.

data.name: PlSql_Direction
data.comment: Table column header: IN, OUT, IN OUT

data.name: PlSql_HasDefaultTitle
data.value: The parameter has a default value – the expression is not in the dictionary, only in the source.

data.name: PlSql_ParametersNote
data.value: Only what the specification declares; private subprograms of the body are not in the dictionary. Oracle shows types declared with {0} as the resolved type.

data.name: PlSql_NoErrorsButInvalid
data.value: No errors stored. The object is probably invalid because something it uses has changed – Oracle recompiles it on the next call.

data.name: PlSql_ErrorPosition
data.comment: Position of a compile error in the source. {0} = line, {1} = column
